title: Trump’s New Shift on Ukraine Leaves Europe Feeling on the Hook
summary: As Ukraine and its allies absorbed the surprise from Donald Trump’s newly upbeat view of Kyiv’s prospects in its war against Russia’s invasion, there were signs of a familiar move by the US president — upping the pressure not on Russia but on Europe.
